text:
maria: quick note about onboarding noise 
maria: our pass/fail gate is catching tiny, explainable diffs and creating churn. thinking about a staged 'fuzzy' acceptance path.

lee: +1. what's the outline?

maria: smoke -> shadow -> canary (1%) -> ramp. composite score of latency p95, token-regress%, and a golden-set eval metric. rollback window during canary.

aj: need to define golden metric precisely (semantic vs exact). also want tokenizer normalizer to reduce spurious diffs.

sophia: agree on distributional eval (spearman/kl) and per-model metric mapping. we'll provide a normalization matrix.

devon: infra needs: (1) lightweight policy store/versioning, (2) gate service + realtime aggregator for composite scores and alerts. doable as a 2-sprint spike.

lee: UX: Console should surface an 'acceptance funnel' and clearly label fuzzy-models in shadow/canary.

aj: ops: when canary is marginal, queue a human review with auto-captured diffs and examples. integrate with oncall.

maria: action items: infra spike (devon), normalization + metric mapping (sophia + aj), funnel mockups (lee), runbook update (maria). target spike demo in 2 weeks.

ingest-bot: canary job started for model rwd-xl-v2 (job cid-179935) — shadowing 1% traffic.

sophia: I'll upload a small golden-set and normalization matrix to the model repo today.

maria: thanks all. If no objections we'll iterate toward an RFC after the spike. :thumbsup:
